    Temporal transfer cross-validation

    Source: R/rsample-splits.R
    inv_temporal_transfer_cv.Rd

    Forward-chaining resampling for invasion data: each resample trains on records up to a time period and assesses on the following period(s), so models are always evaluated on their ability to predict the future of an invasion, never the past. With cumulative = TRUE the analysis window grows; otherwise it slides with a fixed width of initial periods.

    Usage

    inv_temporal_transfer_cv(
  .data,
  time = NULL,
  initial = 5,
  assess = 1,
  gap = 0,
  cumulative = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    .data

    A data frame or inv_occurrence() table.

    time

    <tidy-select> Time column. Defaults to the time column of an <inv_occurrence>.

    initial

    Number of distinct time periods in the first analysis set.

    assess

    Number of time periods in each assessment set.

    gap

    Number of time periods left out between analysis and assessment sets, to avoid leakage between adjacent periods.

    cumulative

    Should the analysis set grow (TRUE) or slide (FALSE)?

    Value

    An rset of class inv_temporal_transfer_cv with columns splits and id.

    Examples

    slices <- inv_temporal_transfer_cv(inv_sdm_data, time = year, initial = 10,
  assess = 3)
slices
#> #  Temporal transfer cross-validation: 3 slices, growing window, assess 3, gap 0
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   splits             id    
#>   <list>             <chr> 
#> 1 <split [1407/416]> Slice1
#> 2 <split [1823/467]> Slice2
#> 3 <split [2290/409]> Slice3
